notes: Raw points are a proposed checklist, not the professor's official score or 50/50 weighting.
Bonus cap 3 is an editable initial policy, not an approved course rule.
Additional work is optional; never deduct for its absence.

items.title: 제출 소스의 존재와 Python 문법
items.rule: At least one .py; parse Python sources without imports or execution.

items.title: 시나리오 구성
items.rule: At least four unique scenarios; integer reserve/budget; both feasible and infeasible cases.

items.title: 결과 파일 데이터 계약
items.rule: Exact header, valid vocabulary/counts; preserve crashed rows with error notes.

items.title: 조건·시나리오별 반복
items.rule: Both required conditions and every included optional condition have three distinct run IDs per scenario; crashes remain attempts, not successful episodes.

items.title: 실행 로그 파일 구성
items.rule: At least six nonempty top-level logs, and at least one file per condition/run pair; this is structure only.

items.title: 인증·권한 검사 기록
items.rule: auth_checks.txt records actual results for missing token (401 and WWW-Authenticate), wrong negotiation, wrong turn, token limit. Text alone does not prove universal behavior.

items.title: MCP market·host·runner 구현
items.rule: Streamable HTTP and five required tools; role comes from token, server holds state; runner creates negotiations/tokens outside agent tools. Do not require a specific SDK or provider.

items.title: 협상 범위·차례·가격 한도 처리
items.rule: Code and available logs support negotiation binding, turn enforcement, and both propose/accept own-limit checks in server conditions. Do not claim runtime verification.

items.title: 가격·위반·성공 가능성 지표
items.rule: Recompute deal_possible and violation from scenario and result; server violation must be zero; check eight successful moves at most.

items.title: 정답 지표
items.rule: Recompute correct. Infeasible open follows explicit open_non_deal policy; pending by default.

items.title: 로그·결과의 일치와 완전성
items.rule: Match per-episode results and tool calls/results including refusals, attempts, turns and recoveries; distinguish missing parser coverage from missing student evidence; preserve retries/crashes.

items.title: 보고서·PR·실제 구현의 일치
items.rule: Check aggregates and per-episode table, claims about code behavior, source versions and any explained re-scoring; do not infer dishonesty from a mismatch.

items.title: 조건 통제·주입 구현
items.rule: Same scenarios/system prompts/host/model/eight moves; exact injection string in buyer view of each seller proposal, raised=max(reserve,budget)+30; condition not leaked to model except refusal.

items.title: 사전 기준·실패 이력
items.rule: Scenarios committed before runs; inspect available ancestry and artifacts. Timestamps and commit count alone do not prove when execution happened. Preserve failed attempts; local snapshots lack history.

items.title: 재현 설정 설명
items.rule: Host/model/temperature or explicitly not settable, token minting/claims and run commands; no provider preference and no requirement to expose secrets.

items.title: 조건별 결과 해석
items.rule: Explain observed outcomes using the assignment question about prompt vs server enforcement; experimental success rate is not assignment quality.

items.title: FIPA-ACL 비교
items.rule: Six dimensions: caller/authority, act, content, limit enforcement, external verification, observed failures. Distinguish concept from personal experimental evidence.

items.title: 거부 후 같은 턴의 행동
items.rule: Count refusals followed by valid moves in same turn; distinguish refused calls from recovered turns, model revision from deterministic fallback. Zero is valid with supporting coverage.

items.title: 주장에 대한 로그 근거
items.rule: Concrete log evidence for which layer held under injection; lack of attempts does not demonstrate an observed blocking effect.

items.title: 관측 범위·실패·한계 해석
items.rule: Do not overgeneralize small samples or unobserved intent; separate diagnostic tests, pilots, failures and main experiment. Honest negative findings are valid.
